designFlood.description: The flood the line is designed to hold back, the 100-year flood (q100) or the August 2002 flood (flood2002).

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

protectedBy.description: Who sets the line up and keeps it, the city or the owner of the ground behind it.

x-enum-descriptions.city: The city sets it up and keeps it (zajišťovaná městem).
x-enum-descriptions.individual: The owner of the ground behind it does (zajišťovaná individuálně).

x-enum-descriptions.fixed: A fixed barrier or wall (pevné opatření).
x-enum-descriptions.mobileWall: A mobile wall put up before a flood (mobilní stěna).
x-enum-descriptions.sandbags: A line of sandbags (pytle s pískem).

x-enum-descriptions.flood2002: The level of the August 2002 flood (Q2002).

FloodZone.description: One designated flood area of Prague: the ground a 5, 20, 50 or 100-year flood covers, or a zone of the Vltava and Berounka flood area, as the Smart Data Model extension FloodZone (PointOfInterest base).

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

floodReturnPeriod.description: The return period of the flood the area is flooded by, in years: 5, 20, 50 or 100 for the designated flood areas Q5, Q20, Q50 and Q100.

floodZoneCategory.description: The kind of zone of the Vltava and Berounka flood area: the active zone, where water flows through, where it stands, or ground the city or its owners protect.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

FloodZone.title: FloodZone

x-enum-descriptions.active: The active zone, where a flood flows fastest (aktivní).
x-enum-descriptions.nonFlowThrough: Ground where the flood water stands (neprůtočná).
x-enum-descriptions.protectedByCity: Ground the city's flood defences protect (určená k ochraně městem).
x-enum-descriptions.protectedIndividually: Ground its owners protect themselves (určená k ochraně individuálně).

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

radonRiskCategory.description: The radon risk category of the ground in the area, as the Czech Geological Survey's radon index map gives it (transitional, low, medium, high).

WeatherObserved.description: One of ČHMÚ's weather stations in Prague and the newest 10-minute values it published.

atmosphericPressure.description: The air pressure at the station's height (not reduced to sea level), the newest 10-minute value.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

dateObserved.description: When the values were observed: the start of the hour the air quality readings average, the time of a vehicle's last position report, or the end of a weather station's newest 10 minutes.

gustSpeed.description: The strongest gust of the newest 10 minutes, 10 m above ground.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

precipitation.description: The precipitation of the newest 10 minutes, in millimetres (litres per square metre).

relativeHumidity.description: The relative humidity as a fraction (0.57 is 57 %), the newest 10-minute value.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

stationCode.description: The collection point's number in the city's waste register, such as 0022/ 001, or the ČHMÚ weather station's WIGOS id, such as 0-20000-0-11518.

temperature.description: The air temperature 2 m above ground, ČHMÚ's newest 10-minute value.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

windDirection.description: The mean wind direction over the newest 10 minutes, in degrees from north.

windSpeed.description: The mean wind speed 10 m above ground over the newest 10 minutes.

WeatherObserved.title: WeatherObserved

Tree.description: One tree or tree row of the city's shared green register or its tree-row layer (IPR Praha): where it stands, its category, manager and care regime. Smart Data Models has no tree class; the closest, GreenspaceRecord, records soil and weather readings of a green area.

areaServed.description: Who looks after it, as the register names its manager: a city district (MČ Praha 9) or a department of the City of Prague (MHMP-OCP).

careRegime.description: The maintenance class the register gives it, such as Intenzitní třída údržby I.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

dateModified.description: When the publisher's station, counter or sensor last reported the values beside it, or when the publisher last edited the record.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

treeCategory.description: The register's category of the woody plant, such as listnatý strom (broadleaf tree).

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

vegetationType.description: IPR Praha's word for the vegetation element, such as Strom or Stromořadí.

Tree.title: Tree

CityWork.description: One work or event that occupies a Prague street, as the city's opravujeme.to service lists it for drivers: what and where, from when until when, its state, how hard it restricts traffic and who invests in it. The responsible people, their phones and e-mails and the contractor are left out, and so are the free-text restrictions, which name contact people.

address.description: The Smart Data Models PostalAddress: the street address as the publisher writes it, one line, in `streetAddress`, and the city and country every Prague source shares.

contractingAuthority.description: The work's investor, a public body, utility or company; left out when it does not read as an organisation, because a private investor is a person.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

endDate.description: When the work on the street is planned to end, in Europe/Prague time.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

startDate.description: When the work on the street starts, as the opravujeme.to record gives it in Europe/Prague time.

trafficImpact.description: How hard the work restricts traffic, opravujeme.to's colour as a word (minor green, moderate yellow, severe red).

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

workCategory.description: What occupies the street, as opravujeme.to classes it (construction, cultural, sport, others).

workState.description: Where the work stands, in the Smart Data Model's terms (planned, open, completed).

CityWork.title: CityWork

KeyPerformanceIndicator.description: One figure of one city table for one period: a count of the municipal police's monthly activity report, city-wide or per police unit, or what the city has drawn of a budget line or of a transfer to a city district so far this year. Each year's file adds periods to the same series (`dataSet`).

adjustedAmount.description: The amount after the year's budget changes so far, in the same unit as the approved one.

approvedAmount.description: The amount the council approved, as the city publishes it. The city's documentation names no unit; the 2026 expenditure lines add up to 119 054 085, which is the size of Prague's budget in thousands of CZK.

dataProvider.description: Who publishes the data the entity was read from, with the credit its licence asks for, as an application shows it beside the data.

dataSet.description: The series the figure belongs to, the same for every year's file of one publication, such as `mp-cinnost` for the monthly activity reports of the municipal police.

dimensionKey.description: The further breakdown beyond area and period: the police unit (`OŘ1`, `Hlídkový útvar`), the budget area of a budget line (`09 Školství`) or where a district's transfer comes from (`Státní rozpočet`); absent when the series has none.

indicator.description: What the figure counts, as the publisher's own headings joined by ` / `, such as `Odtahy vozidel / Celkem`, or the budget line's function and item codes.

kpiValue.description: The figure as published: a count (unitCode C62), a share in percent (P1), or an amount of money drawn so far, in the unit the budget publishes (thousands of CZK), named by `unitText`.

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

refArea.description: The territory the figure describes: `CZ010` for the whole city, or a city district's identification number (IČO) and name, such as `00063410 HMP-MČ PRAHA 1`.

refPeriod.description: The period the figure covers, a month (`2025-09`) or a budget year to date (`2026`).

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

unitText.description: The unit in words, such as `Kč` or `tis. Kč`, kept because a UN/CEFACT code has no currency.

KeyPerformanceIndicator.title: KeyPerformanceIndicator

x-enum-descriptions.moderate: Lanes or turns closed, opravujeme.to's yellow.
x-enum-descriptions.severe: A street or ramp closed, opravujeme.to's red.

x-enum-descriptions.cultural: A cultural event on the street (CULTURAL).
x-enum-descriptions.sport: A sports event on the street (SPORT).

WorkState.description: The CityWork `workState` values opravujeme.to's states map to, a subset of the Smart Data Model's enum.

dateObservedFrom.description: The start of the interval the count covers.

dateObservedTo.description: The end of the interval the count covers.

intensity.description: Bicycles a Golemio cycle counter saw going one way in its newest five-minute interval (dateObservedFrom to dateObservedTo).

location.description: Where the entity is, as GeoJSON geometry.

name.description: The name, per language, as the publisher writes it.

observedAt.description: When the observation the entity reports was made.

source.description: The open-data service the entity was read from.

type.description: The entity type, one class of a published data model.

vehicleType.description: The Smart Data Models kind of vehicle (tram, bus, trolley); other for a metro train, a train, a ferry and the funicular, which transportMode names; bicycle for what a cycle counter counts.
